ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 98:2 ratio of low-intensity (dark) to high-intensity (white/light) pixels on the visible fluke surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark low-intensity field across both lobes; sparse, isolated high-intensity clusters concentrated in the distal regions of the left lobe and lower central region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad, shallow U-shaped indentation at the central vertical axis; estimated internal angle between lobe trajectories is approximately 150 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations with vertical amplitudes ranging from approximately 3 to 12 pixels across the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse distribution of white circular pixel clusters, approximately 3-8 pixels in diameter, primarily visible on the mid-region and distal third of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear pixel sequences (rake marks) traversing the dark surface; specifically 3-4 parallel lines on the left mid-lobe and 2 horizontal lines on the right mid-lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized reddish-brown irregular pixel clusters at both distal tips; prominent white linear scarring on the inner left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly uniform dark pigmentation across the entire visible surface area with minimal macro-scale white mottling.
